comments.value: I did smal research and found that parameters[0] in RenderVector3andSpacePropertyEditor is expected to be Vector4 but it's not always true, some times it's Transform or other GameObject references that probably comes from neighbours SendRPC or other actions for some reason.
I put this small patch (highlighted code) and now it works fine. But I guess something is worng with serialization if wrong types comes from ParameterDecoder.

Bug still exsit in 2018.06.21.13.02, but now VRCSDK2.VRC_Serialization.ParameterDecoder returns null, so now I added null-check to fix. And it also writes error into console about "broken" serialization data, but I can not give the log right now, because I lost it and I didn't encounted more errors and can not reproduce yet.

details:
How to reproduce:
In existing VRC_Trigger in any event type click "+" in Actions section -> Basic Events -> SetAngularVelocity or AddAngularVelocity or what ever action uses vector fields, then click on just created action. Some times Editor (Inspector) is breaks, not all controls rendered (Action "+" / "-" , other actions and events disapears) and rendered controls not working. Following error appears in console:

InvalidCastException: Cannot cast from source type to destination type.

SDK version is 2018.06.06.10.46

Only way to make editor work after that is to switch to Debug and remove broken action manualy.
title: SDK: Some times VRC_Trigger breaks with InvalidCastException when using new SetAngularVelocity (and others vector actions)
